name: Pieter Van Der Merwe
bio:
Pieter's motorsport journey began amidst the roar of engines at Kyalami, where his father worked as a mechanic. Immersed in the world of racing from a young age, he developed an astute understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance. While his driving aspirations were cut short by a lack of funding, his technical aptitude and keen eye for detail led him to a career coordinating test drivers.

Pieter's approach is rooted in rigorous data analysis and relentless pursuit of improvement. He believes that a successful test program is built on clear communication, meticulous preparation, and a willingness to challenge conventional wisdom. He is known for pushing his test drivers to their limits, extracting every ounce of performance data possible, but also fiercely protects their safety. His experience makes him invaluable to Prema Junior, optimizing car setups and development strategies.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a receding hairline
physical.description: A powerfully built man with a stern, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn stopwatch, even in meetings.
Insists on drinking rooibos tea before every test session.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of racing history and trivia.
